observations.evidence: The postulate defines the model only on the open exterior r>r_+, but writes Φ_H using A_t(∞)-A_t(r_+) as point evaluations outside that domain. Q/r_+ is correct when these denote one-sided limits; the postulate should state those limits or explicitly inherit the earlier definition.

The cited scattering definition is on r>r_+ and defines A_t=-Q/r there, while [F1] summarizes Φ_H as A_t(∞)-A_t(r_+) using endpoint evaluations. The value Q/r_+ is valid as a limit difference; [F1] should state that convention or cite Φ_H=Q/r_+ without the undefined evaluations.
